name: metakocka-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your Metakocka ERP: documents, invoices, stock, products and partners. Read-only by default; creating offers, invoices, received invoices, partners and products can be turned on. Works in Slovenian and English (slovenščina in angleščina).
long_description: Connects Claude to your Metakocka ERP so you can ask questions about your business in plain language: who owes you money and how overdue they are, top products last month, stock in a warehouse, or the full detail of a sales order. By default it is read-only. Creating offers (ponudbe / predračuni), invoices (računi) and received invoices (prejeti računi, copied from the supplier's PDF) can be turned on in the settings, and so can adding new partners and products: documents are linked to partners and products that exist in Metakocka (or that you have just added), and you confirm each one before it is saved. Invoices are saved not issued, for you to check and issue in Metakocka. It never changes or deletes anything. Requests go directly from your computer to Metakocka's API. This is an independent community project, not made or endorsed by Metakocka d.o.o.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Find offers, orders, invoices, purchase and warehouse documents.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: One document in full, by id or number (e.g. PP-18495).

tools.name: get_document_pdf
tools.description: Save an invoice as PDF on this computer.

tools.name: find_by_tracking_code
tools.description: The sales order behind a parcel tracking code.

tools.name: list_search_filters
tools.description: Advanced search filters available for a document type.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Product catalogue search, optionally with stock and prices.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product in full: stock, incoming orders, prices, bill of materials.

tools.name: get_stock
tools.description: Stock, reserved and free amounts per product and warehouse.

tools.name: low_stock
tools.description: Products to reorder: out of stock, below safety stock, over-reserved.

tools.name: stock_movements
tools.description: One product's stock history for a period.

tools.name: stock_valuation
tools.description: Estimated stock value per warehouse at last purchase prices.

tools.name: list_warehouses
tools.description: All warehouses.

tools.name: search_partners
tools.description: Customers and suppliers by name, tax number, e-mail or phone.

tools.name: get_partner
tools.description: One partner in full, with open receivables and payables.

tools.name: partner_statement
tools.description: Statement of account with dated payments and payment behaviour.

tools.name: get_unpaid_invoices
tools.description: Open receivables or payables with aging and top debtors.

tools.name: sales_summary
tools.description: Revenue for a period, grouped and optionally compared with an earlier period.

tools.name: purchase_summary
tools.description: Spending on supplier invoices, grouped and optionally compared.

tools.name: get_bank_statements
tools.description: Money in and out per bank account, with transactions.

tools.name: draft_document
tools.description: Prepare an offer, invoice or received invoice from existing partners and products, without saving it (only when creating them is on).

tools.name: draft_partner
tools.description: Prepare a new partner (e.g. a supplier from its invoice), without saving it (only when adding partners is on).

tools.name: draft_product
tools.description: Prepare a new product, e.g. to book a received invoice to, without saving it (only when adding products is on).

tools.name: commit_document
tools.description: Save a prepared document, partner or product in Metakocka after you confirm it (only when creating them is on).

tools.name: discard_draft
tools.description: Drop a prepared document, partner or product (only when creating them is on).

company_id.title: Company ID
company_id.description: Your Metakocka company ID. In Metakocka, enable API access to see it.

secret_key.title: Secret key
secret_key.description: Your Metakocka API secret key. Treat it like a password; it is stored in your system keychain.

base_url.title: Metakocka URL
base_url.description: Leave as is for the public Metakocka. For another installation, enter its address: a domain, internal host name or IP, e.g. https://erp.example.com or http://10.0.0.15:8080. /rest/eshop/v1 is added when no path is given; without http:// or https://, https is used.

ca_cert.title: CA certificate (optional)
ca_cert.description: Only for an installation with a company or self-signed TLS certificate: the CA certificate file (PEM) to trust. Takes effect after restarting Claude.

timeout_seconds.title: Request timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for Metakocka before giving up. Raise it if large reports time out.

cache_seconds.title: Cache duration (seconds)
cache_seconds.description: How long warehouses and partner lookups are reused before asking Metakocka again. 0 turns caching off.

pdf_dir.title: PDF folder (optional)
pdf_dir.description: Where invoice PDFs are saved. Default: Downloads/Metakocka.

allow_offers.title: Allow creating offers
allow_offers.description: Let Claude create offers (ponudbe / predračuni) in Metakocka, linked only to partners and products that already exist. Off by default.

allow_invoices.title: Allow creating invoices
allow_invoices.description: Let Claude create invoices (računi, domestic and foreign) in Metakocka, also from an offer. They are saved not issued: you check and issue them in Metakocka. Off by default.

allow_purchase_invoices.title: Allow entering received invoices
allow_purchase_invoices.description: Let Claude enter received invoices (prejeti računi, domestic and foreign) from the supplier's invoice, with its PDF attached, booked to products that already exist. Off by default.

allow_partners.title: Allow adding partners
allow_partners.description: Let Claude add a missing partner (e.g. a new supplier, from its invoice) when you agree. Checked for duplicates and confirmed by you. Partners can only be deleted in Metakocka itself. Off by default.

allow_products.title: Allow adding products
allow_products.description: Let Claude add a missing product (e.g. to book a received invoice to) when you agree. Checked for duplicates and confirmed by you. Off by default.

confirm_documents.title: Confirm each document
confirm_documents.description: Confirm every document before it is saved in Metakocka: Claude Desktop asks you to approve the save and shows the document's summary. Don't choose "Always allow" for it. Turn off only if Claude may save documents without asking.
